attacks.name: Brain Freeze
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Suppressive|: After this attack is resolved, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.

attacks.name: Neuro-Annihilation
steps: The defender cannot add additional dice to its defense roll or modify its defense dice.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Call me Maximus the Magnificent! (Affiliation: Inhumans)
superPowers.body: The first time each Turn an allied character attacks or defends, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it must use this Leadership. Reroll 1 of its attack or defense dice. If the rerolled result is a |!failure|, after the attack is resolved, your opponent Places the allied character within |!range| 1 of its current position and this character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Did you Forget Why You‘re Here?
superPowers.body: Choose a character within |!range| 3 with an Activated token. Advance that character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: It‘s Madness, My Favorite Kind
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character makes an attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step this character may use this superpower. This character rerolls 2 of the attacking character's dice.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.
